title: eXc Keystrokes
description: A clean keystrokes overlay that lights up your WASD, space and mouse buttons as you press them, with a live CPS counter. Styled in a turquoise to purple gradient.
body:
A clean, lightweight keystrokes overlay for Minecraft. Your movement keys, space
and mouse buttons light up as you press them — perfect for recordings, streams,
or just watching your own inputs. Comes with a built-in CPS counter.
